data.action: 樱树下抱紧捧花兴奋靠近，粉绿长辫与头纱落在腰间，眼神闪亮
data.description: 【蝶屋樱花庭院·春日午后】蜜璃穿着粉白婚纱站在盛开的樱树下，长辫的绿色发梢落在腰间；她双手抱紧捧花，看到镜头便兴奋地连说好美，眼下的小痣和满脸红晕让整座庭院都变得明亮。
data.lighting: rosy spring sunlight through falling petals
data.mood: 热烈而温柔的恋柱誓约
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji from Kimetsu no Yaiba wears a pink-and-white wedding dress with a green sash, petal embroidery and a long translucent veil. She hugs her bouquet beneath the cherry tree, her pink braids fading to green beside the veil. She leans toward the viewer with sparkling green eyes, overwhelmed by the flowers, the promise and the simple happiness of being admired in return. rosy spring sunlight through falling petals.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 樱色庭院的恋柱花嫁
